name: undecylenic acid
uses: Uses Treats most Athlete's Foot(Tinea Pedis) and Ringworm. Relieves itching, scaling, cracking, burning, redness, soreness, irritation and discomfort. Helps prevent most athlete's foot (dermatophytosis) with daily use.
otcwarn: Do not use on children under 2 years of age unless directed by a doctor. Ask Doctor irritation occurs, there is no improvement within 4 weeks (for athlete's foot and ringworm). Stop Use irritation occurs, there is no improvement within 4 weeks (for athlete's foot and ringworm).
